selfConsistency.reason: LMC kinematic snap — sky cone + bulk-PM gate matched, distance snapped to Pietrzyński 2019's 49.594 kpc eclipsing-binary anchor. See SCIENCE.md § LMC kinematic override.
LMC kinematic snap (see sibling entry). Bright supergiant whose AT-HYG G_R3 distance underestimated the LMC anchor by ~50×.
Noisy Gaia DR2 inverse-parallax (G_R2 input, 147 pc); Bailer-Jones 2021 DR3 posterior re-anchors to multi-kpc — the same override shape as the G_R3 cases above, just on a DR2-sourced input.

FL Aqr — HIP2 parallax is unusable (5.16 ± 34.71 mas), so AT-HYG's 193.8 pc is noise. Intra-system coherence snaps it to its CPM companion FK Aqr's clean Gaia anchor (14.55 pc), matching FL Aqr's accepted ~14.4 pc. Legitimate correction, not a regression.

simbad.reason: Yellow hypergiant ρ Cas. SIMBAD's distance is 1000/plx_value off the noisy Hipparcos parallax (~1.06 kpc); modern Gaia DR3 + Bailer-Jones posterior places ρ Cas at multi-kpc. Stellata's pipeline value (6.35 kpc) is the more physically correct one — the disagreement reflects SIMBAD lagging modern distance estimates for highly uncertain supergiant parallaxes, not a pipeline bug.
